groups.distinction: RequestAdapterError distinguishes failed adapter criteria from unset environment selection; native per-backend diagnostic fields are explicitly not stable public API. Cooperative matrix scalar kind and M/N/K dimensions describe native kernel layout, not bespoke game quantity roles.
groups.uses: RequestAdapterError formats explanations from requested/supported/active/no-adapter/incompatible/no-fallback masks. These are independent failure facts, not interchangeable state tags. Matrix ab_type versus cr_type distinguish input and accumulator precision even with same enum.
groups.disposition: Keep native request failure owner and precision/layout distinctions. Actual application stage wrapper can retain RequestAdapterError rather than clone backend bitfield taxonomy. Native Boolean saturating accumulation is capability flag, not game mode.
groups.acceptance: Later first-party adapter admission/readiness trace must distinguish missing adapter from invalid surface/device/map stages while preserving cause. No driver request or native matrix execution, no unrelated prefix API proof.

groups.distinction: Native ECS wrappers InstanceColor, InstanceHistory, buffer/bind-group components and GPU opt-in marker provide query/extraction/resource role even with same underlying native storage. GPU InstanceData packs position+scale, rotation, vertexindex, batch andseed; world_from_local and previous_world_from_local have different temporal/frame roles.
groups.uses: Rust extraction carries same data with transform/AABB; uniform conversion initializes native max halfextents until realAABB supplied. WGSL fields/binding groups match native shader layout; calc_instance_world_matrix interprets angle radians, uniformscale and parentlocal transform in direct kernel. Visibility Vec4 packs near/far fade intervals consumed by dither kernel.
groups.disposition: Keep native framework role wrappers: they select ECS/render resources and prevent query/binding mix-ups. Do not flatten history matrix into current transform or treat seed/index/batch as interchangeable game IDs. Required WGSL numeric/packed layouts are adapters, not justification for raw first-party retained state. No arbitrary enum per vertex index/binding slot.
groups.acceptance: Later actual first-party native upload producer must retain its own frame/unit/count/identity until exact adapter and preserve compatible native packing, layout and history. Invalid batchMAX and maxAABB are native protocol/initialization observations only; no invented physical maximum or ordinary app error claim without actual producer. No native shader/GPU run or unrelated render consumer proof.
